verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter's own pages describe an attorney-led model: each client is paired with one dedicated attorney for the whole case, and the firm drafts the petition, brief, and letters and files the I-140 itself. It explicitly rejects fill-in-the-blank petitions and charges a flat attorney fee with a refund guarantee. Missing for 10: named attorneys or bar-admission credentials, explicit attorney-of-record (G-28) language, and independent corroboration of attorney involvement.
